name: EuroSAT: Land Use and Land Cover Sentinel-2 Benchmark
description: A popular deep learning benchmark dataset for land use and land cover (LULC) classification based on European Space Agency Sentinel-2 satellite imagery. Developed by the German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI). Comprises 27,000 georeferenced 64x64 pixel image patches covering 10 distinct LULC classes (such as Annual Crop, Forest, Herbaceous Vegetation, Highway, Industrial, Pasture, Permanent Crop, Residential, River, and Sea/Lake) across 34 European countries.
